description: This file defines the LanguageBlock class for a Drupal module, providing a 'Language switcher' block with methods for access control, building the block, and creating placeholders.

classes.name: LanguageBlock
classes.description: A Drupal block plugin providing a language switcher interface, with access control and cache management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the language manager and path matcher dependencies.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Determines access permissions based on whether the site is multilingual.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the language switcher block, including cache metadata and links.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder for the block, returning TRUE.
